opening.argument: The material presents a practical walkthrough of free Microsoft Virtual Academy training, beginning with the website and continuing through ordinary access steps. Viewers are shown how to create an account, enter registration details, answer questions to progress, and complete skills testing before obtaining a certification described as free. The sequence is instructional and focused on navigating the training platform, with no indication that the separate merchandise link forms part of that process.
